summary: Implemented the LP position valuation module at `src/robinhood_lp/features/position.py` per the T051 contract. The module covers all seven contract deliverables: (1) raw `token0` / `token1` inventory via `compute_raw_inventory` (delegating to the T049 sizer's `get_amounts_for_liquidity` so the V4 floor rounding is the single source of truth); (2) the in-range / out-of-range state via `classify_range_state` and the `RangeState` enum, treating the V4 `[tick_lower, tick_upper)` bracket convention (left-inclusive, right-exclusive); (3) the principal inventory as a separate ledger (`PrincipalState`) that is never a PnL field; (4) fee-growth accounting via `compute_fee_growth_inside` (the V4 standard conditional that subtracts the appropriate outside(s) from the global accumulator) and `compute_lp_fees_owed` (the V4 `mulDiv` floor division); (5) protocol-fee separation per the Owner amendment of 2026-09-16 via `split_protocol_fees`, which scales combined-fee inputs by `(lp - protocol) / lp` with floor rounding and is the identity on LP-only inputs; (6) collections / mint / burn / add / remove as a typed snapshot lifecycle (`snapshot_at_mint`, `snapshot_after_modify`, `apply_mint`, `apply_collect`, `apply_burn`); (7) donations and verified hook credits via `apply_donation` and `apply_hook_credit`, gated by the T043 `HookEvidenceState` so unverified hook deltas are never silently folded into a balance. The canonical entry point is `compute_position_valuation`, which is a pure function of the position identity, the liquidity, the point-in-time `PoolState`, the `PoolFeeState`, the position's `FeeGrowthSnapshot`, the `PrincipalState`, and the T043 hook verdict. The Owner amendment of 2026-09-16 (LP fees exclude the protocol share represented by T040's point-in-time directional protocol-fee state) is enforced structurally: the `protocol_fees_0` / `_1` fields are populated by `split_protocol_fees` and recorded in the canonical output. The must-not clauses are encoded: `PositionKey` is the `(tick_lower, tick_upper, salt)` triple with an optional `token_id` metadata field, and a defensive test asserts the type never exposes any `sender` / `owner` / `from_address` attribute; the principal ledger is a balance field, never a PnL field, and a defensive test asserts the valuation type never exposes any `pnl` / `realized_pnl` / `unrealized_pnl` / `return` / `yield` attribute. Acceptance coverage includes below / at-lower / inside / at-upper / above Range states (the redundant 'at' tokens in the contract text are folded into on-boundary tests), reversals (the same position's inventory is recomputed at a different `sqrt_price_x96` without any PnL recomputation), add / remove / collect operations (full lifecycle in `test_add_remove_lifecycle`), native currency (the module is raw-integer-agnostic; native-ETH inventory is exercised at the boundary), decimal asymmetry (token0/token1 with different decimal scales is exercised without any decimal conversion inside the module — the T053 boundary owns that), and combined-fee / protocol-fee rounding (pinned integer vectors in `tests/fixtures/features/position_vectors.json` cover the V4 fee-growth-inside conditional, the V4 mulDiv floor, the LP / protocol split, and the RangeState classification). 116 tests pass; the full P05 / P04 / P01 / P03 / P02 / P00 test suite passes (1644 tests, with 6 environmental skips); ruff format, ruff check, and mypy --strict on the entire `src/` tree all pass.

residual_risks: The `PositionKey.token_id` field is recorded as optional metadata (the V4 NFT identifier the framework may receive from an authenticated Position Manager indexer) but is never used to derive an `owner` wallet identity — the structural guard relies on `PositionKey` exposing only the on-chain event triple. If a future caller passes an attacker-controlled tokenId, the framework still treats the position identity as the `(tick_lower, tick_upper, salt)` triple, so the wallet-inference vector stays closed; downstream consumers reading `token_id` should re-validate it against a trusted source rather than treating it as a wallet identity.

The Owner amendment of 2026-09-16 records the protocol-fee separation rule, but the underlying V4 wire format does not embed the per-token directional protocol fee in any pool-wide accumulator (the `feeGrowthGlobal*` accumulators are LP-only by V4 design; the protocol fee is tracked separately via the `ProtocolFeeUpdated` event). When the caller supplies LP-only `fee_growth_global_*` values (the `PoolFeeState.is_lp_fee_growth = True` path), `split_protocol_fees` is the identity and `protocol_fees_*` are zero. When the caller supplies combined-fee growth (the `is_lp_fee_growth = False` path), the framework scales by `(lp - protocol) / lp` with floor rounding per the amendment. If a future contract amendment changes the per-side protocol-fee semantic (e.g. asymmetric per-token), the `split_protocol_fees` API is the single point that has to evolve; the rest of the module is independent.

The T043 hook-evidence gate is currently a caller-provided `HookEvidenceState` value. The position layer never reads a hook pack itself; the audit trail records the verdict in `PositionValuation.hook_evidence_state`. The framework's `apply_hook_credit` rejects unverified hook credits outright (T043 must-not) and `apply_donation` records but does not fold in donations when the evidence is unverified. If T043's evidence policy changes (e.g. a new verification tier), `HookEvidenceState` is the only enum the position layer depends on.

The pinned integer vectors in `tests/fixtures/features/position_vectors.json` are reproducible from the T012 Python port of the V4 math; the V4 source pin is `e50237c43811bd9b526eff40f26772152a42daba` per `docs/implement/evidence/ORACLE_MANIFEST.md`. Re-running the same Python functions reproduces each vector byte-exactly. The vectors cover (a) the V4 fee-growth-inside conditional for below / inside / above Range, (b) the LP-fees-owed floor division, (c) the LP / protocol split floor rounding, and (d) the RangeState classification at the boundaries. Future V4 source-pinning changes that touch the math will require re-pinning the vectors; the source-commit metadata in the fixture's `_meta` block records the current pin.
